### [`load_cave_data`](../../../../src/cave/setup.asm#L6) `$8226`

*routine*

Copies the 240 bytes of cave data to cave_data when the cave changed. Sets the level seed and the cave colours.

- **Called from:** [`start_cave`](cave_start.md#start_cave)

*routine*
